text:
Maya (docs): FYI opened PR #1247 — migration guide (v1 -> v2 SDK), includes new examples and a couple of link fixes. Need a style/voice pass + someone to sanity-check the JS snippet.
Jess R: I can do the voice pass. aiming for a quick sweep today.
Tom H: I can review the JS/TS snippets tomorrow morning. ping me if you want me to run them locally.
Avery (eng): I triggered docs preview, but linkcheck failed on one external reference. waiting on CI details.
docs-bot: Rendered preview: https://deploy-preview-1247--docs.redwood.ai/ -- status: partial (linkcheck failing)
CI Bot: docs-lint: warning on terminology: uses "model" in places where we prefer "model variant" for serving docs. linkcheck: broken link at migration.md#installing-legacy (HTTP 404)
Maya (docs): Thanks. For terminology: we should prefer "serving" over "inference" in conceptual docs unless describing runtime internals. Also prefer second-person imperative for quickstart steps ("Run", "Install"), and active voice.
Jess R: Noted — I'll replace passive phrasing and check all occurrences of "inference". Also will ensure examples use the "client.generate(...)" shape we standardize on.
Tom H: Quick look at the JS snippet: the auth example uses process.env.API_TOKEN — can we show the SDK constructor pattern we shipped in v2? e.g.
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-x-1', input: 'Hello' });
```
Tom H: That aligns with the SDK reference. I'll confirm types and the import path.
Avery (eng): I found the broken link — it's referencing an older internal page. I pushed a tiny commit that swaps to the canonical getting-started URL and updated the anchor.
Maya (docs): Awesome. After Jess's voice pass and Tom's snippet check, I'd like to hold merge until post-release merge window on Thursday to avoid docs churn during the site deploy. Can we tag reviewers as REQUIRED?
Jess R: tagging: @Tom H, @Avery (eng) as reviewers and marking for docs-team review. Also adding a style checklist comment in the PR description.
Tom H: I'll run the snippet locally tonight and update types/live output if needed. If all good, I can approve Thursday AM.
Maya (docs): CI statuses to watch: docs-lint, linkcheck, mkdocs-render. docs-bot provides preview link when mkdocs-render passes.
CI Bot: mkdocs-render: queued
Avery (eng): small nit on tone: the migration guide currently says "we deprecated X" — change to "X is deprecated in v2" to remove org-centric voice.
Jess R: good catch. I'll make that tone edit. Also: document examples should show both sync and async snippets for JS and Python where possible. Keep examples under 10 lines each.
Maya (docs): Reminder: avoid brand-new jargon without definition. e.g., mention "model variant" once, then stick to it. Add a parenthetical for any term used first time.
Tom H: done a quick run, fixed the import path and updated the example in a small commit. Tests/examples execute locally.
Maya (docs): Great — once CI is green, please leave approvals. I'll merge during the Thursday merge window (after 14:00 PT) unless any new issues show up.
Jess R: Approved pending CI green.
Avery (eng): Approving once mkdocs-render is successful.
docs-bot: Rendered preview URL updated: https://deploy-preview-1247--docs.redwood.ai/ (all checks passing) :tada:
Maya (docs): Merged on Thursday 14:10 PT. Backporting: create a small follow-up to cherry-pick the link fix to 2.1 branch.
Tom H: I'll open the backport PR after merge.
Maya (docs): Thanks everyone. Follow-up: I'll add a short blurb to the release notes about the migration guide and include the sample snippets.
Jess R: thanks — will audit the rest of the migration docs next sprint for consistent voice.
Avery (eng): LGTM.
CI Bot: All checks passed for PR #1247.
